prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic Y2K fashion portrait of one approved adult woman reclining on a pink bench in a monochromatic locker room.

She wears a minimalist black string bikini as a supplied fashion reference, with gathered top cups, center ring detail, and side-tie bottoms, plus pink accessories.

Right hand holds a pink heart-shaped pen over an open lavender-lined notebook; left hand rests naturally.
Pink lockers in alternating bubblegum and rose shades, pom-poms, heart padlocks, and stickers.
Soft high-key illumination keeps subject and locker background crisp.
